evidence.reason: Made the platform-time-error expectation host-independent by recording only the OSError class (emit.py now drops the host-dependent errno message, the checked-in utilization.json omits it, and the differential runner compares expect.message only when the fixture records one), so emit.py --check holds on any host regardless of the gmtime errno text; tests not run locally because the harness permits only git commands.
